runner: run_openvla_oft_libero.py: openvla-oft experiments/robot/libero/run_libero_eval.py (GenerateConfig, initialize_model, prepare_observation, process_action) and its run_episode loop
env_seed: env.seed(0) in get_libero_env; global seed 7 set once
max_steps: episode_lengths per suite if set, else --env.episode_length in the extra flags if set, else LeRobot defaults (spatial 280, object 280, goal 300, libero_10 520)
note: Official openvla-oft LIBERO settings: 2 images + proprio, L1-regression action head, chunks of 8 actions open-loop, center crop, 256 px env images, 10 no-op steps, max steps 220/280/300/520, unnorm_key <suite>_no_noops, seed 7. The combined 4-suite checkpoint (paper appendix: 96.8% vs 97.1% for the per-suite ones). Env roboelo-openvla-oft: transformers fork moojink/transformers-openvla-oft, torch 2.7.1+cu128 instead of the pinned 2.2.0 (RTX 5090), MuJoCo 3.3.2, robosuite 1.4.1, tensorflow 2.15. An exception is recorded and the rollout re-run (the official loop counts it as a failure).
policy_settings: as stored in the checkpoint (policy_config.json) unless overridden by the extra flags
